ood_description: UCI Leaf DOI 10.24432/C53C78 RGB-only, disjoint unsupported species, supported genera excluded; CIFAR-10 pinned source train/tune and test/audit; exact and conservative near-duplicate removal; capture-session IDs unavailable. See reports/ood_provenance.json.
limitations: Empirical audit on supplied images, not proof of universal OOD rejection. Audit cannot be reused to tune thresholds; collect a fresh audit set after changes.
split_limitation: Complete physical-leaf separation cannot be verified for source-image groups without physical-leaf metadata. Perceptual hashing detects near-identical views, not every view of the same leaf.
